article.title: Synthetic research: learning from small trials
author: Ada Example
article.selection_reason: 原创合成案例，用于验证逐段对照、结构化分析和词汇的无损归档。

segments.en: A small team records a hypothesis before each pilot. A baseline helps the team distinguish evidence from enthusiasm.
segments.zh: 一个小团队在每次试点前记录假设。基线帮助团队区分证据与热情。
segments.heading: A fictional method

segments.en: The team compares the observed outcome with the baseline and examines the trade-off. A constraint can be informative even when the result is uncertain.
segments.zh: 团队将观察结果与基线比较，并审视其中的取舍。即使结果不确定，一项约束也可能带来信息。

segments.en: Iteration creates useful feedback, but momentum is not proof of scalability. An incentive can change behavior without improving the underlying process.
segments.zh: 迭代会产生有用反馈，但势头并不能证明可扩展性。激励可能改变行为，却没有改善底层流程。
